model: Frozen Grounding DINO Tiny, default processor FP32, public .4 box/.3 text cutoffs. Original complete navigation language converted by already fixed _english_destination to phrase, matched via detector label suffix. Highest confidence qualifying box; RGB features = detection present flag, confidence, normalized box width/height, absolute offset of center from image center in x/y, fraction of frame edges touched. No detection -> zero vector. No classes, paths, ids, pose, geometry or annotated boxes to classifier.
arms: Baseline stops if both fresh views yield matching centered DINO box. Candidate adds seven-variable L2 logistic regression on fixed features, unbiased intercept, no threshold sweep, near if score >=.5 in BOTH consecutive real acquisitions. No-bbox abstains in both. Matched centered bbox required in both at inference. No near label from held-out VLM use.
sampling: Training in 840139,841012,841150; group equally by label type (near-matched, near wrong instruction, far same instruction), then by target instance within type; development only 839992; abstentions enter denominator. Same classifier for all classes. Fit via sklearn LogisticRegression(C=1,max_iter=500,random_state=20261117) on linearly scaled standardized TRAIN features; normalized sample weights sum to n, so regularization stable. Evaluate paired confirmation if true dual fresh frames exist; if static duplicated/cropped data, no two-frame claim.
gates: Before 839934 online run require (i) at least 3 independently identified development near target instances with same-image wrong and far same-target negatives each, (ii) nonzero joint positive and zero incorrect confirmations in both negative groups, (iii) at least half eligible positive instance groups correctly confirmed, candidate meets or beats baseline near recall at zero negative errors; show scene/instance group CIs and counts. No calibration on 839934. A dev failure means no online change tested. 840818 held aside.
data_disclosure: Record pose and distance only in offline scoring; near disk waypoint and ray-box visibility proxies separate. Record precise near/negative definitions of collection including any missing groups.
